title: Intro to C
line: Compile by hand, then learn pointers, structs and memory.

project.title: A train line as a linked list
project.brief: Write line.c on your own. Build a linked list of train stops with malloc, insert a stop in the middle, print the line in order and free every node.
checks: line.c compiles with -Wall and no warnings
The stops print in order with the inserted stop in the middle
Every node is freed before the program ends

lessons.title: Compile and run your first program
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to write hello.c in VS Code with main and printf, compile it in the terminal with cc hello.c -o hello and run ./hello.
lessons.passes: The hello program exists, prints one line and exits with code 0.

lessons.title: Types and printf
lessons.goal: Teach C int, double and char variables and printf format specifiers by building a paint calculator that prints the litres needed for a wall to two decimals.
lessons.passes: A 5 by 3 metre wall at 10 square metres a litre prints 1.50 litres.

lessons.title: If, for and while
lessons.goal: Teach C if, else, for and while with the remainder operator by writing a prime finder that prints every prime below 50.
lessons.passes: The program prints the 15 primes below 50 and nothing else.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.goal: Teach C functions with prototypes, parameters and return values by writing a leap year checker with an is_leap function tested on four years.
lessons.passes: 1900 and 2023 print not leap, 2000 and 2024 print leap.

lessons.title: Arrays
lessons.goal: Teach C arrays, indexing and looping with a length by storing the weights of seven parcels and printing the lightest, the heaviest and the average.
lessons.passes: The lightest, heaviest and average match the seven values in the array.

lessons.title: Strings
lessons.goal: Teach C strings as char arrays that end in a zero byte, with strlen from string.h, by writing a palindrome checker.
lessons.passes: level and racecar print yes, and hello prints no.

lessons.title: Pointers
lessons.goal: Teach C pointers, with the address-of and dereference operators and passing by pointer, by writing a swap function that trades two ints.
lessons.passes: After the swap call, the two printed values have traded places.

lessons.title: Structs
lessons.goal: Teach C structs, typedef and the arrow operator by building a product inventory of three items and a function that prints one through a pointer.
lessons.passes: Three products print with name, price and quantity through a struct pointer.

lessons.title: malloc and free
lessons.goal: Teach C heap memory with malloc, realloc and free by building a list of numbers that doubles its capacity as ten values are added.
lessons.passes: All ten numbers print and every allocated block is freed.

lessons.title: Split code across files
lessons.goal: Teach C header files, include guards and compiling several files by moving count_vowels and reverse functions into textutil.h and textutil.c.
lessons.passes: cc main.c textutil.c builds a program that prints a vowel count and a reversed word.
